title: qbee-agent: Docker Compose build context Zip Slip writes outside context directory (CVE-2026-129237)
description: qbee-agent contains a Zip Slip vulnerability in its tar extraction logic used for Docker Compose build contexts. The vulnerability arises because the path validation uses a prefix check that does not enforce path separator boundaries, allowing crafted archive entries to write files outside the intended extraction directory. This can lead to arbitrary file writes outside the context directory when the Docker Compose build context is unpacked with UseContext enabled.
